spec: The canonical spelling of a PRACTICE graph instance name. Four transforms, applied in this order: strings.ToLower, then "/" to "-", then " " to "-", then "+" to "plus". The authoritative implementation is store.SlugifyLanguage in cmd/knowledge-server/internal/store/language_detect.go; cmd/knowledge/internal/graphsel.CanonicalGraphName is the client's copy. This file is a DATA file, not a shared Go package: the two binaries are separate modules and share nothing hand-written, so a data file read by a test in EACH module is how the two copies are held to one rule. The table is PRACTICE-ONLY. The singleton families linkage and checks canonicalise to the constant "default" rather than by transform, so they are asserted inline in the tests rather than here.
